Description: This business is the medical practice of Dr. David W. Chou, a facial plastic surgeon. Dr. Chou has an active California medical license (#159036). Dr. Chou is board certified by the American Board of Otolaryngology - Head and Neck Surgery, and completed his 5-year residency at Kaiser Permanente Oakland Medical Center from 2017 to 2022. He then completed a subspecialty fellowship in facial plastic and reconstructive surgery at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City from 2022 to 2023. He practiced facial plastic surgery as a full time academic surgeon at Emory University in Atlanta from 2023 to 2026, and is now moving back to the Bay Area to start his own private practice. This business will be located at 2855 Telegraph Ave, Suite 510, Berkeley, CA 94705. The business at this address will offer consultations for patients seeking facial plastic surgery, such as rhinoplasty, facelifts, eyelid surgery, and reconstructive surgeries. Minor treatments such as Botox and Fillers injections will also be offered, and minor procedures like facial resurfacing for wrinkles and scar revisions. Surgeries under general anesthesia will NOT be performed at this address, but at accredited Ambulatory Surgery Centers and proper Operating Rooms throughout the Bay Area.

Description: Modification to previously approved Use Permit #ZP2021-0161 to obtain an exception from Condition of Approval No. 23 (Demolition). COA #23 currently provides that demolition of the existing building cannot commence until a complete application is submitted for the replacement building, and that all plans presented to the City to obtain a permit to allow the demolition are subject to those conditions. Applicant urgently seeks authorization to demolish the existing approximately 45,000 sq. ft. wood/steel industrial structures and site improvements on the 2.5-acre parcel under separate Demolition Permit Application #B2023-02557 in advance of submittal of the replacement building application due to ongoing crime and life-safety concerns at the site, including repeated trespass, vandalism, illegal dumping, unauthorized occupancy, and fire risk associated with the vacant structures, which pose an immediate hazard to neighbors, first responders, and the public. The previously filed and approved Use Permit #ZP2021-0161 is included by reference. No new structures, residential units, very-low income units, or parking are proposed under this modification.
